question:
Simplify the following expression.

72 − 42 ÷ 6 of 7 × 4 of 3 ÷ 4 × 3 − 5
solution:
**Given:**

72 − 42 ÷ 6 of 7 × 4 of 3 ÷ 4 × 3 − 5

**Concept Used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 72 − 42 ÷ 6 of 7 × 4 of 3 ÷ 4 × 3 − 5

⇒ 72 − 42 ÷ 42 × 12 ÷ 4 × 3 − 5 

⇒ 72 − 1 × 3 × 3 − 5 

⇒ 72 − 9 − 5 

⇒ 72 − 14 

⇒ 58

**⇒ ****Hence, The value of above is 58.**
